notes.title: Update: Local multiplayer and more
notes.content:
The most important thing first:
[h1]Local multiplayer[/h1]
You can finally enjoy Wizard Of Walls with more players on one computer. Select "Start Multiplayer" in the main menu. To add or remove local players, move one of your joysticks to any direction and hold it for 1 second*. You can use up to 4 game controllers and the keyboard.
[img]https://comfortzone.games/res/add_local_player.jpg[/img]
*The first joystick (or keyboard) that you use first in the main menu will stay the master controller and cannot be removed. 
[h2]Local and online together![/h2]
You can combine online and local multiplayer. For example two players on one computer can play together with other two players on another computer via internet. 

[h1]Start position and color selection[/h1]
In multiplayer games you can select your start position and your color. Select "Color + Start Position" in the lobby and select your desired position by moving your joystick (or keyboard) and change color by pressing your fire button (A-Button on controller or left [CTRL] on keyboard). 
Press Menu-/Back-Button on controller or [ESC] on keyboard when you are done.  
Keep in mind, that players cannot use the same start position or color. 
[img]https://comfortzone.games/res/position_selection.gif[/img]
[h1]Chat[/h1]
In the lobby and during gameplay, you can press [C] on keyboard to enter a chat message. Chat messages will be shown at the top of the screen.
[img]https://comfortzone.games/res/chat.jpg[/img]

[h1]Controls[/h1]
Improved controls and reduce some of the "jankyness". Hopefully. Let me know.
D-PADs supported now!
Pause/Back now on the Menu/Back-Buttons of your controller. Not B-Button like before.

[h1]Minor fixes and tweaks[/h1]
- Fixed the UI navigation with joystick (leaderboard and lobby list)
- Removed the "anti camping camera zooming in" mechanic.

notes.title: Update - Some tweaks
notes.content:
[h2]Invulnerability 2 seconds after spawn[/h2]
[h3]Annoying for beginners[/h3]
As you choose the time to spawn by pressing your fire button, you should be able to avoid spawning [i]into[/i] a monster and die instantly. However, beginners sometimes struggle with getting back into the game after they've died. 
[h3]A real issue in PvP mode[/h3]
Another issue - and this is even more important - is, that when you play PvP (unchecking the "coop" checkbox in the host options), players could just wait infront of your spawn point and keep firing at your spawn position. This way, you don't have any chance to spawn without beeing hit immediately.
[h3]Solution[/h3]
Solution for both issues: The player is now unvulnerable for the first 2 seconds after spawn (shown by a blinking player figure). So, it's now a little bit easier to get into the game for beginners and camping at the opponent spawn point in PvP mode will be punished (as a spawning player cannot be hit by you, but also can shot in your direction at the same time)

[h2]The zooming in camera[/h2]
Have you wondered, why the camera suddenly starts zooming in until you can barely see your environment and totally lose overview?
This is an anti-camping mechanism. When you stay still for a while, the camere will start zooming in, until you've walked away from this point minium 2 units. The problem here was, that the game wasn't communicating why the zoom happens and left players confused. I've fixed this by displaying a message saying "You lose overview when you stand sill".

notes.title: Balancing, Leaderboard, Sound
notes.content:
[h1]Improvements[/h1]

[h2]Balancing the spiders[/h2]
Problem: In higher levels the spiders did drop an egg [i]immediately [/i]after you've shot the last one. This way, you never get to shot the last egg. Fixed. There's a minimum delay now. And they don't put eggs if there are more than 30 spiders in the dungeon. Exponential growth is hard to balance.

[h2]Worluks and Wizards[/h2]
To keep it interesting in the higher levels, from dungeon 20 there will come two worluks and two wizards. From dungeon 40 it will be three and so.

[h2]Leaderboard[/h2]
When your game's over, where will show a message if you've reached a new record. "Congratulations! You are ###. in the leaderboard!".
When you open the leaderboard, it will go to the page containing your name and highlight the row with your record.
[h2]Sound[/h2]
I've added stereo/3d sound to all relevant sounds. More immersion! Good!

Also some minor bug fixes in the networking/multiplayer code where made.
